name: Time Surf
source:
Hero who is an apprentice of time and space masters with the aim to get a license and learn flying. His master requests to travel to different time spaces and exterminate four wanted female time criminals.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是时空大师的学徒，目标是取得执照并学会飞行。他的师父要求他穿梭于不同的时空，消灭4名被通缉的女性时间罪犯。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
